title: GSA Per Diem Rate Lookup Input

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: List of locations to look up: [{ "city": "Austin", "state": "TX" }] or [{ "zip": "78701" }]. Cities not on GSA's specific list return the standard CONUS rate automatically.

year.title: Fiscal year
year.description: Federal fiscal year to look up rates for.

apiKey.title: GSA API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Optional free API key from api.gsa.gov. Falls back to the public DEMO_KEY, which works but may be rate-limited under heavy use. Get your own free key at https://open.gsa.gov/api/perdiem/ for larger batches.
